answer: Sybil resistance derives from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: an identity must provide sustained, honestly reciprocated service to accumulate durable EigenTrust eigenvector centrality. Freshly spawned sybil identities begin near zero, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify their influence without trusted links, so they cannot pass consensus. The delta between established peers and an orchard or tundra of new accounts remains decisive.
